s.title: Proxy Monster Settings
s.servers.title: Servers
s.servers.desc: The proxy-monster servers you sign in to. Each sign-in reaches the datasources you have access to.
s.hint.busy: Finish signing in in your browser.
s.hint.endedUntil: Database connections work until {time}. Sign in again to use AI apps.
s.hint.ended: Sign in again to use AI apps and connect.
s.hint.signedOut: Sign in to reach this server's datasources.
s.form.changeDesc: Changing the address signs you out of this server.
s.form.addDesc: The Connect page of your company's console can do this for you.
s.form.name: Name
s.form.nameHint: Short and lowercase. You'll see it in menus and in pmon commands.
s.form.errName: Enter a name for this server.
s.form.errUrl: Enter the full address, starting with https://
s.empty.title: No servers yet
s.empty.body: Open the Connect page in your company's proxy-monster console, or add the server's address here.
s.stopped.title: Proxy Monster isn't running
s.stopped.body: Start the background service to see and use your servers.
s.toast.added: Added {name}. Sign in to start using it.
s.ai.title: AI Apps
s.ai.desc: Let an AI app on this computer query the datasources you can access. It signs in as you, so masking and approvals still apply.
s.ai.appDesc: Query your datasources from {app}, with your access.
s.ai.signedOut: Signed out — sign in to use it
s.ai.noneBody: Install Claude Desktop, Claude Code or Codex, then come back here.
s.ai.noServerBody: AI apps use a server you've signed in to.
s.ai.staleBody: AI apps run the pmon inside this app, and the background service is a different build. Restart it before connecting an app.
s.general.title: General
s.general.desc: How Proxy Monster starts, looks and keeps you informed.
s.general.loginDesc: Start Proxy Monster when you log in, so your sign-in status is always in the menu bar.
s.general.loginHint: Turned on after your first sign-in.
s.general.loginUnavailable: Needs macOS 13 or later and the app installed from its installer.
s.general.appearanceDesc: Applies to this window and the menu-bar menu.
s.general.notificationsDesc: You'll get a notification 30 minutes before a sign-in ends, and when it has ended. Click it to sign in again.
s.general.notificationsHint: Change how they appear in System Settings › Notifications.
s.about.license: Open source under the Apache 2.0 license.
s.general.updatesDesc: Download new versions as they come out, and install them when no database connection is open.
s.general.updatesHint: Proxy Monster restarts itself to finish an update.
s.webviewMissing: Settings needs the Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime, which is not installed or could not start. Open its download page?
s.general.loginDesc.windows: Start Proxy Monster when you sign in to Windows, so your sign-in status is always in the notification area.
s.general.appearanceDesc.windows: Applies to this window. The notification-area menu follows Windows.
s.general.notificationsHint.windows: Change how they appear in Windows Settings › System › Notifications.
ai.after.claude-desktop.windows: Claude Desktop can use it now.
